- **IBM Plex Sans**: weights400,500,600 obtained2026-09-21 from the Google Fonts CSS endpoint `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&display=swap`, which references the font files on `fonts.gstatic.com`.
